label: Exploratory V5 range/damage candidate A
assumptions: This is not nimble-knots-artillery-v5 and has no runtime, replay, protocol, or reward authority.
It keeps V4 world, turns, movement, and ideal-direct-hit projection only to inspect whether three non-dominated range/damage roles can exist before real ballistic tuning.
Threadball, Needlepoint, and Spoolburst target three, four, and two ideal direct hits respectively against 100 Stitching; real terrain, aim, splash, and pacing can change those outcomes.
